name: TS Tech Co Ltd
summary: TS TECH Co., Ltd. is a global leader in the design, production, and distribution of a wide array of seating and interior components. While specializing in automotive seating solutions, the company also manufactures interior trims and various parts for vehicles, alongside motorcycle seats and resin-based accessories for two-wheelers. Their product line features a comprehensive selection, including front, mid, and rear car seats, door panel finishes, specialized chairs for medical care, and robust offerings for off-road and recreational applications. Established in 1948, the firm, headquartered in Asaka, Japan, operates extensively across numerous international markets such as Japan, the United States, Canada, Mexico, Brazil, China, Thailand, the Philippines, India, Indonesia, the United Kingdom, and Hungary. The company was formerly known as Tokyo Seat Co., Ltd. before officially changing its name to TS TECH Co., Ltd. in October 1997.
